features.text: Redesigned the weekly menu around a day selector, with lunch and dinner shown separately and the current day pinned while you scroll
Rebuilt Settings: everything is visible at once, with a Light/Dark/System switch and allergens as tappable chips
Added Impressum and Privacy Policy pages in German and English

improvements: Faster app: smaller images, quicker startup, and menu text that appears instantly
Opening a meal now reuses the photo that is already loaded instead of downloading it again
The installed iOS app now shows a proper launch screen instead of a black screen
Settings closes with Escape and works fully with the keyboard
Feedback now goes through a simple hosted form instead of a maths captcha
Your settings now stay on this device only. Sync Codes and cross-device syncing have been removed
Removed the Protein and Balanced highlight filters
Rewrote the privacy policy to follow Swiss data protection law and explain exactly what the app does (and doesn't) store
fixes: Fixed Obere Mensa UZH showing no menus
Fixed UZH restaurants sometimes appearing empty on Monday mornings
Fixed "CHF 0.00" prices in the UZH weekly menu
Fixed the weekly menu showing the wrong day late in the evening
Fixed dark mode on the weekly menu, in Settings and in the opening hours
Fixed the top bar blur on iOS 26, Chrome and Android
Fixed the iOS home screen icon showing a letter instead of the Mensa Mate icon

features.text: Added ETH Student Card (Legi) quick access directly from the navigation bar
Added new Protein and Balanced highlight filters to instantly find top macro picks

improvements: Implemented instantaneous client-side navigation for zero-delay restaurant switching
Significantly improved app performance with aggressive API caching
Redesigned empty states with a cleaner look and fun icons
Refined the Menu Detail UI with a more discrete close button
Disabled rubberbanding in the Menu Detail view for a native-feeling scroll on iOS
Cleaned up dead code and internal architecture
fixes: Fixed an issue causing UZH meal images to crash the app
Corrected nutrition labels to dynamically show 'per serving' for UZH and 'per 100g' for ETH
Fixed an issue where the iOS home screen icon wouldn't display correctly

changes: Greatly enhanced performance on the web, and especially on mobile via PWA
Added a new diagram view for nutritional information
Enhanced the menu item view design
Fixed the initial loading delay for favorite restaurants
Improved UI responsiveness on iOS devices
Improved the layout and functionality of the weekly menu view
knownIssues: Data synchronization is not yet functional
Vertical scrolling in the weekly menu encounters issues on desktop browsers
